reuse: Existing original seed and new-seed barbac observations are read from validated caches; run only missing competitors on six 1x development inputs. Pilot timing is not part of final timing results.

final_sample_size_rule.approach: Use the largest paired F1 difference SD across 8 contrasts and a Bonferroni paired-t approximation. Minimum 30, round up to a multiple of 5, cap at 60. Report target power as unmet if the cap is binding; never increase n after final results.

boundary: No final input generated before a separately fixed boundary model, tests and sample-size record.
